head: 0930dfeb93f7b6f805fd1373b3a199a6c9755d5c
title: fix(coach): complete food review, exact totals and real targets (FOOD-COACH-124, T4)
body:
FOOD-COACH-124, agent 124. **T4: coach-facing health-data correctness.**

## Fixed normal-day problems
- **B1 — missing recorded meals:** A coach reviewing a normal month of food sees only the latest 100 entries and incomplete totals. Load all supported `mealsCursor` pages before displaying a complete review.
- **B2 — wrong daily total:** A coach reviewing fractional portions sees calorie totals different from the client's daily endpoint because rounded row values were added together. Sum exact nutrition × stored multiplier products, then round only the daily display.
- **B3 — wrong target comparison:** A coach opening a client's summary sees no prescribed target and a false 0% comparison because camel-case profile fields were read instead of the prescription/server profile contract. Use live coach targets first, then actual server-computed profile targets, with explicit unavailable/unset states. Percentages above 100 remain truthful; only the visual bar is bounded.

## Highest-value usability improvements
Daily protein/carbs/fat totals, averages explicitly over logged days, current-target comparisons labelled as current (not historical), recorded eat-date labels and original portions/notes, direct entry to existing client messaging and meal plans, actionable refresh/retry, clear consent-withheld versus empty states, and 44-point period controls.

No automatic adherence score: existing food logs do not prove meal-plan completion. No new completion tracking, inferred plan matching, invented nutrition targets, or zero-intake assumptions.

## Proof
Fourteen focused rendered regressions in `src/__tests__/coachFoodReview124.test.tsx`; the PR's own CI runs full typecheck/lint/tests. The one extra [unchanged-main CI lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37516259903) exposed the rounding regression but also an async-render test-harness mistake; that harness is corrected here and the lane is not claimed as clean proof for all findings. Local targeted validation is recorded in the agent report when available.

## Independence and merge order
Mobile-only; existing deployed timeline cursor and macros endpoints are used unchanged. Does not edit the client logging files owned by #396, shared API/data-hook files owned by #397, or backend coach/macros files. #398's later `ClientDetailScreen.tsx` initializer change and this PR's food props are disjoint; coordination recorded in the claim file. No dependency on unmerged feature code.

No lockfiles, schemas, configuration, production writes, native builds, spending, merge, or deploy.

Both T4 lenses must review the exact head once CI is green.

### B-404-1 — Summary treats withheld food data as measured zero intake

**Normal-user story:** A coach opens Summary for a client whose food sharing is off and is told the client has eaten zero calories and `0% of daily target`, rather than that intake is not shared. [Summary](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c916b2cf1c9304037a1e4d64a35067188aac3ab9/src/screens/coach/client-detail/SummaryTab.tsx#L52-L88)

**Location:** `src/screens/coach/client-detail/SummaryTab.tsx:52-88`, with `useClientDetailData.ts:46-85`. The server deliberately returns empty entries and zero aggregates together with `consent.food_macros: false`; the data hook discards that flag, while this PR resolves the real prescribed target and renders those withheld aggregates as intake and a target percentage. This is a false nutrition claim, not a leak of the withheld entries. [Server withholding contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/c402a098a317960c47fd5fc5a2ba008676828b63/src/coach/coach.service.ts#L421-L492) · [Data projection](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c916b2cf1c9304037a1e4d64a35067188aac3ab9/src/screens/coach/client-detail/useClientDetailData.ts#L46-L85) · [New comparison](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c916b2cf1c9304037a1e4d64a35067188aac3ab9/src/screens/coach/client-detail/SummaryTab.tsx#L52-L88)

**Required fix:** carry food-sharing state through the data hook and `ClientDetailScreen` into Summary; when false, replace intake totals, macro intake cards and intake percentages with the explicit not-shared state. Coach-prescribed targets may remain independently readable. The Food log review tab already handles withholding correctly. [Correct review-tab state](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/blob/c916b2cf1c9304037a1e4d64a35067188aac3ab9/src%2Fscreens%2Fcoach%2Fclient-detail%2FFoodLogReviewSection.tsx)

**Proof:** the independent Sol probe uses the real data hook and Summary with the actual consent-withheld response shape; it fails because the rendered screen contains `0% of daily target` when the assertion requires no intake percentage. The single test fails at the behavioral assertion, not setup. Verified the probe's sole parent is this PR head, and the lane adds only workflow/manifest; this reuses the cancelled continuation's one existing lane, with no additional run.
